A Next.js file marked use server exports editOrder(orderId, fields). It has no session or role check. Only the admin orders page imports it, and that page is behind an admin layout. Give the verdict for this opening.

POST /api/auth/send-otp takes a phone number and sends a new one-time code by SMS on every call. It does not wait for the previous code to expire and has no per-number or per-caller limit. Give the verdict for this opening.

GET /api/posts returns published blog posts to anyone, by design. The limit parameter has no server-side maximum. The table holds a few hundred short rows and the query uses an index. Authentication, ownership and input handling are otherwise proven. Give the verdict for this opening.
